description: This file defines an ExceptionHandler class that implements Thread.UncaughtExceptionHandler to handle uncaught exceptions by logging the error, starting an exception activity, finishing the current activity, and terminating the runtime.

classes.name: ExceptionHandler
classes.description: Handles uncaught exceptions in a separate thread, logs the exception and triggers an activity to display the error.

methods.name: ExceptionHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with an Activity context.

methods.name: uncaughtException
methods.description: Method invoked when an uncaught exception occurs; logs the error and initiates UI and shutdown procedures.
